unsupported_claims: 'Yes, you can move them to the USB drive and keep them safe' -> the page never says a USB drive keeps files safe and does not mention backups; Cut and Paste to one USB leaves a single copy
reasons: G1 unsupported 'keep them safe' claim about the USB drive. It overpromises for family photos.
fix: Change the opening to 'Yes, you can move them to the USB drive instead of deleting them:' and remove 'keep them safe'. Keep the six steps. Keep the closing note but base it on the page wording: you can still use the files when the drive is connected, but they will not take up space on the PC.

Then keep the restart and Power troubleshooter steps as a second try ('If that does not help, restart the laptop, then ... next to Power select Run'). Keep to about five steps.
